item.name: Copy an element from a source document

oauth2.value: OAuth2Internal OAuth2ReadPII OAuth2Read OAuth2Write OAuth2Delete OAuth2Purchase OAuth2Share document.create document.edit document.delete document.read enterprise.create enterprise.read enterprise.edit enterprise.delete enterprise.member.create enterprise.member.read enterprise.member.edit enterprise.member.delete webhook.create webhook.edit webhook.read webhook.delete PLMIntegration

request.description:
Specify the target document and workspace in the URL. Specify the source document, workspace, and element in the request body.
If `anchorElementId` is specified, the copied element will be inserted after the anchor element. If not specified, the copied element will be inserted at the end of the tab list.

request.description:
Returns a configuration string in the following form:
`configuration=parameterId%3DparameterValue`
The configuration string can be used in other Onshape API calls to specify which configuration option to use. See the Configuration API Guide for additional details.
